name: DocAccepted
caption: When a supplier document is accepted

configuration.description: Seconds the user waits for the flow at most (default 60). Checked between steps; when it has passed, the run fails and everything it did is rolled back. Missing, not an integer, or <= 0 means 60. Keep it between 1 and 600.

outputs.name: PurchaseHeader
outputs.when: only when the document's Purchase Order No. names an existing order

rules.check: The configuration dialog refuses to save while the timeout is empty.
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: timeoutSec missing, not an integer or <= 0 is treated as 60.
The flow did not finish within timeoutSec. The run is stopped and rolled back; the user sees the message.
rules.message: The flow %1 did not finish within %2 seconds and was stopped. Nothing it did has been kept.

rules.check: The flow runs synchronously, so a step that defers the run (Sleep) fails it.
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested a deferred resume, but the flow is running synchronously. Use Sleep or other time-based deferral steps only outside of synchronous frames (Webhook sync phase or SubFlow body).

rules.check: An error in the flow (e.g. an Error step) rolls back this record's run and stops the page action at this record; the user sees the flow's message.
Only supplier documents with status New can be accepted or rejected. Raised before any flow runs.
rules.message: Supplier document %1 is already %2. Only new supplier documents can be accepted or rejected.

notes: Requires the AutoFlow Supplier Foundation app, which depends on AutoFlow and AutoFlow Core. See docs/apps/SupplierFoundation.md.
Interactive: fired by a page action for one record at a time; every published flow on the trigger runs inline in the user's session, one after the other, with the same outputs.
No commits while the flows run. Each record's run (all flows) is one transaction, committed before the next record.
Publish: no trigger-specific checks and no Job Queue entry.
The page action is shown only while at least one flow is published on the trigger (Accept/Reject are always shown).
Outputs marked 'only when …' are not set when the condition fails; a {{trigger_<name>}} token for them then stays in the text verbatim.
Re-entrancy guard: a flow that fires its own trigger again is skipped, not recursed into.
